items: At the wardrobe, dressing table, shoe rack and the other stations, the camera now frames you whole, on the part you're choosing (your head, your top, your shoes), instead of aiming at your feet with your head off screen; zooming in first no longer pushes it closer still
At a station, Enter, E or Space (or A or X on a gamepad) chooses what's highlighted; landing on an item you own still puts it on straight away, and choosing one you haven't found yet says so
A look you chose at the dressing table no longer gets swapped back for an older one if you changed your mind quickly
